## Tutorials

The Trim() function removes both leading and trailing spaces from a string.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Trim("    SQL Tutorial    ") AS TrimmedString;

---

Trim(
string
)
```

## Tutorials

The UCase() function converts a string to upper-case.

Tip:Also look at theLCase()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT UCASE(CustomerName) AS UppercaseCustomerName
FROM Customers;

---

UCase(
text
)
```

## Tutorials

The Abs() function returns the absolute (positive) value of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Abs(-243.5) AS AbsNum;

---

Abs(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The Atn() function returns the arc tangent of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Atn(5) AS AtnNum;

---

Atn(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The Avg() function returns the average value of an expression.

Note:NULL values are ignored.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Avg(Price) AS 
  AveragePrice FROM Products;

---

Avg(
expression
)

---

SELECT * FROM Products
WHERE Price > (SELECT Avg(Price) FROM Products);
```
